title: compute/v1 sandbox egress
description: A sandbox's outbound network (README.md "Egress"): its allow list (POST /v1/sandboxes `network`, PATCH /v1/computers/{id}/network) and the platform-wide deny list (PUT / DELETE /v1/admin/egress-deny/{host}). Enforced at the sandbox node's egress proxy; a refused request is answered 403 with one line naming the host and the list that refused it (`$defs/refusal`).

host.description: A host name, lower case, at least two labels (the last one starts with a letter), no port, no trailing dot: `api.example.com` matches exactly that host; `*.example.com` matches every name under example.com (`a.example.com`, `a.b.example.com`), not example.com itself. IP addresses are not names: a sandbox with an allow list reaches no address by IP.

anyOf.description: An IPv4 address, refused when a request names it literally.

network.description: The hosts commands in the sandbox may reach (HTTP and HTTPS through the node's egress proxy, ports 80 and 443). Absent on a sandbox: every public host, as before this field existed. Present: only these, plus what this layer's own client needs (its NetBird network and the identity issuer; README "Egress"). An empty list reaches nothing else. The platform deny list applies first either way.

networkUpdate.description: PATCH /v1/computers/{id}/network: the new allow list of a sandbox (replaces the old one), or null for none (every public host again). The node's proxy applies it within 10 seconds; open connections are not cut.

networkState.description: A sandbox's egress as this layer holds it (PATCH answer). `allow` null: no list, every public host.

cause.description: Why the entry exists, shown in every refusal it causes and in the logs (e.g. `scorer-fault:42`, `abuse:ticket-17`): printable ASCII without spaces.

denyRequest.description: PUT /v1/admin/egress-deny/{host}. Putting the same host again replaces its entry (a new expiry or cause).

expiresAt.description: When the entry ends by itself: in the future, at most 30 days ahead.

entries.description: Live entries (an expired one is gone).

reason.description: Which list refused: not-declared = the host is not in the sandbox's allow list; blocked-by-platform = the platform deny list (an operator entry, its `cause` named) or a range no sandbox reaches (private, link-local and metadata addresses: cause `private-address`); port-not-allowed = only ports 80 and 443 (CONNECT only to 443).

refusal.pattern: ^EGRESS_DENIED host=\S+ computer=\S+ reason=(not-declared|blocked-by-platform|port-not-allowed)( cause=\S+)?( until=\S+)? retryable=(true|false) next=.+$
refusal.description: The body of the proxy's 403 (one line; also in the response header `X-AgentCompute-Egress` with `;` between the fields): `EGRESS_DENIED host=<host> computer=<cmp_…|unknown> reason=<reason> [cause=<cause>] [until=<expiresAt>] retryable=<true|false> next=<what to do>`. retryable is true only for a deny entry that expires (`until`). The SDK parses it (`parseEgressRefusal`).
